subcommands.description: Lock your voice channel so nobody else can join

subcommands.name: voicemaster music
subcommands.description: Toggle music mode: only you and permitted members can speak in your channel

subcommands.name: voicemaster panel
subcommands.description: Resend the interface panel (to the #interface channel by default)

subcommands.name: voicemaster permit
subcommands.description: Let a member or role join your voice channel even when it's locked

subcommands.name: voicemaster reject
subcommands.description: Stop a member or role from joining your voice channel (disconnects them)

subcommands.name: voicemaster rename
subcommands.description: Rename your voice channel (once every 10 minutes)

subcommands.name: voicemaster reset
subcommands.description: Remove the VoiceMaster configuration (and optionally its channels)

subcommands.name: voicemaster role
subcommands.description: Give members a role while they're in your voice channel

subcommands.name: voicemaster setup
subcommands.description: Create the Join to Create channel and the #interface panel

subcommands.name: voicemaster status
subcommands.description: Set the status shown under your voice channel (leave empty to clear it)

subcommands.name: voicemaster transfer
subcommands.description: Give ownership of your voice channel to another member in it

subcommands.name: voicemaster unghost
subcommands.description: Reveal your voice channel in the channel list

subcommands.name: voicemaster unlock
subcommands.description: Unlock your voice channel so anyone can join

webhooks.name: webhook
webhooks.description: Relay messages through webhooks with a custom username and avatar

subcommands.name: webhook create
subcommands.description: Create a webhook in this channel, you'll get an identifier to use it with

subcommands.name: webhook delete
subcommands.description: Delete a webhook

subcommands.name: webhook edit
subcommands.description: Edit a message sent through one of this server's webhooks

subcommands.name: webhook list
subcommands.description: View every webhook created with Blep in this server

subcommands.name: webhook send
subcommands.description: Send a message through a webhook. Add more embeds with --add, override the name/avatar with --username and --avatar
